units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: б) a specialist, expert or interpreter is recused, if that recusal prevents consideration of the case on the merits;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: в) it is necessary for a person participating in consideration of the case to appear, to request additional case materials or to order an expert examination;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: г) malfunctions arise when using videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: д) the judge, body or official considering the case has reasonable doubts as to whether the person participating in consideration of the case is the person who underwent identification or authentication, or concerning that person’s expression of will;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) a procedural order shall be issued for compulsory appearance of a person whose participation in consideration of the case is recognised as mandatory, in accordance with part 3 of Article 29.4 of this Code;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 9) a procedural order shall be issued transferring the case for consideration by the competent authority in accordance with Article 29.5 of this Code;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 10) a procedural order shall be issued appointing defence counsel for a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for commission of such an administrative offence within the period provided for by this Code, if, at the time the administrative offence case is considered, that person is outside the Russian Federation and it is not possible to duly notify that person in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code.
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. When consideration of the administrative offence case continues, the administrative offence record and, where necessary, other case materials shall be read out. The explanations of the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, testimony of other persons participating in the proceedings, explanations of the specialist and the expert’s opinion shall be heard, other evidence shall be examined, and, where the prosecutor participates in consideration of the case, the prosecutor’s opinion shall be heard.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Where necessary, other procedural actions shall be performed in accordance with this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. An administrative offence case whose materials are attached to a record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code shall be considered by the judge to whom that record was sent, where that case concerns the same person and the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), or where, in proceedings in that case, a ruling imposing an administrative penalty was issued against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction).
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.7

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case shall be drawn up when the case is considered by a collegial body.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. The minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case shall specify:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) the date and place of consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the name and membership of the collegial body considering the case;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) the occurrence of the administrative offence under consideration;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) information on the attendance of persons participating in consideration of the case and on due notification of absent persons;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) applications for recusal, motions and the results of their consideration;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) explanations, testimony, clarifications and opinions of the relevant persons participating in consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) documents examined during consideration of the case.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. The minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case shall be signed by the person presiding at the meeting of the collegial body and the secretary of that meeting.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.8

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Following consideration of an administrative offence case, a ruling may be issued:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) imposing an administrative penalty;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) imposing an administrative penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code and terminating proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by another Article (part of an Article) of Chapter 12 of this Code, proceedings in which are being conducted against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) imposing an administrative penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code, and also quashing a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), in which proceedings were conducted against the same person, and terminating proceedings in that case in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) terminating proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, and also leaving unchanged a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), in which proceedings were conducted against the same person.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. A ruling terminating proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be issued where:
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) at least one of the circumstances provided for by Article 24.5 of this Code exists;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1.1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) an oral admonition is given in accordance with Article 2.9 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1.1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) proceedings in the case are terminated and the case materials are transferred to the prosecutor, a preliminary investigation body or an inquiry body where the actions (inaction) contain indications of a crime;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1.1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) a person is exempted from administrative liability for the administrative offences provided for by Articles 6.8 and 6.9, parts 2, 4 and 6 of Article 14.5, Articles 14.32, 15.11, 15.15.6, 15.21, 15.27.3 and 15.30, parts 1 and 2 of Article 16.2, Articles 19.7.13, 19.15.1, 19.15.2 and 19.28, and part 2 of Article 20.20 of this Code, in accordance with the notes to those Articles.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1.1 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Following consideration of an administrative offence case, a procedural order shall be issued:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) transferring the case to a judge, body or official authorised to impose administrative penalties of a different type or amount or to apply other measures in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) transferring the case for consideration by the competent authority if it is established that consideration of the case does not fall within the competence of the judge, body or official that considered it;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) returning the administrative offence record and other case materials to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, where the record was drawn up and other case materials prepared by unauthorised persons, the record was incorrectly drawn up and other case materials improperly prepared, or the submitted materials are incomplete and that incompleteness cannot be remedied during consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) returning the administrative offence case to the body whose official sent the record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code and the attached materials specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code, if it is established that the case concerns another person and/or another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), or that, in proceedings in that case, a ruling imposing an administrative penalty was issued against another person or in respect of another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction).
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 29.9

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall specify:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) the position, surname, first name and patronymic of the judge or official, or the name and membership of the collegial body, that issued the ruling, and their address;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the date and place of consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) particulars of the person in respect of whom the case was considered;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) the circumstances established during consideration of the case;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for commission of the administrative offence, or the grounds for terminating proceedings in the case;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) a reasoned decision in the case;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) the time limit and procedure for appealing the ruling.
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. Where an administrative fine is imposed, in addition to the information specified in part 1 of this Article, the ruling in the administrative offence case shall contain the information required under the rules for completing payment documents for transfer of the amount of an administrative fine provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the national payment system, and information on the amount of the administrative fine that may be paid in accordance with parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code, indicating the unique charge identifier.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. If, when a judge decides whether to impose an administrative penalty for an administrative offence, the question of compensation for property damage is also decided, the ruling in the administrative offence case shall specify the amount of damage to be compensated and the time limits and procedure for compensation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: When a judge imposes an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activity, the question shall be decided of measures necessary to ensure enforcement of that administrative penalty and consisting in prohibiting the activities of persons conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, legal entities and their branches, representative offices, structural subdivisions and production sites, and the operation of units, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of certain types of activity (work), or the provision of services; and, where administrative suspension of activity is imposed as an administrative penalty for violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism, the question of measures necessary to suspend transactions on accounts shall also be decided.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.10 · “When a judge imposes an administrative penalty in the form of…”

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: When issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case, the judge shall decide whether to return the security for an arrested vessel to the person who provided it or to forfeit that security to the state, and this shall be stated in the ruling in the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.10 · “When issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case, the…”

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: When issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case concerning a foreign citizen or stateless person, the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case shall decide whether to place the foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution if imposing on that person an administrative penalty in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.10 · “When issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case…”

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: When imposing an administrative penalty with an obligation to undergo diagnostics, preventive measures, treatment for drug addiction and/or medical and/or social rehabilitation in connection with consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances, the judge shall specify in the ruling in the administrative offence case the period within which the person must apply to the relevant medical organisation or social rehabilitation institution. That period shall be calculated from the day the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.10 · “When imposing an administrative penalty with an obligation to…”

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. The ruling in an administrative offence case shall resolve questions concerning seized things and documents, things under attachment if an administrative penalty in the form of confiscation has not been or cannot be applied to them, and the security deposited for an arrested vessel. In this connection:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) things and documents not withdrawn from circulation shall be returned to their lawful owner or holder, and, if that person cannot be identified, transferred into state ownership in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) things withdrawn from circulation shall be transferred to the appropriate organisations or destroyed;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2.1) light-industry goods seized from illegal circulation, the list of which is established by the Government of the Russian Federation, shall be destroyed in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) documents constituting physical evidence shall remain in the case file throughout its retention period or be transferred to interested persons in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) seized orders, medals and badges accompanying honorary titles of the Russian Federation, the RSFSR and the USSR shall be returned to their lawful owner or holder or, if that person is unknown, sent to the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) restrictions relating to possession, use and disposal of attached property established in accordance with Article 27.20 of this Code shall remain in force until the ruling imposing an administrative penalty is enforced.
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a collegial body shall be adopted by a simple majority of the votes of members of the collegial body present at the meeting.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.10
